# Contains

Tells whether a string holds a piece of text, or an array holds a value.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Contains(source, value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | any | The string or array to search. Null holds nothing. A number, a boolean, an object or a function is a runtime error. |
| `value` | any | What to look for. In an array, any value, null included, found when an element is equal to it by value. In a string, text found by exact match, case included; a number or a boolean is read as its string form, null is found in no string, and an array, an object or a function is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Boolean. True when source holds value, false otherwise. Never null.

## Example

`Contains("haystack", "st")` returns true.

`Contains([1, 2, 3], 2)` returns true.
